trigger.where: Library toolbar: button that opens the Upload dialog

dialogDescription.where: Library > Upload dialog: screen-reader-only dialog description
dialogDescription.context: PDF, MusicXML, MuseScore are file formats; keep the names.

uploadedSuccess.where: Library > Upload dialog: success message after upload

dropPrompt.where: Library > Upload dialog: drop zone text; the zone can also be clicked to browse for a file
dropPrompt.context: {browse} is the word 'browse' (key browse), shown in the accent colour

browse.where: Library > Upload dialog: the accent-coloured word inside dropPrompt; clicking the zone opens the file picker

acceptedHint.where: Library > Upload dialog: small hint under the drop zone
acceptedHint.context: {max} is the size limit in megabytes (a number); MB is the unit.

fileSizeKb.where: Library > Upload dialog: selected file's size
fileSizeKb.context: {size} is a whole number of kilobytes; KB is the unit.

removeFile.where: Library > Upload dialog: icon button accessible label that clears the selected file

titleLabel.where: Library > Upload dialog: label of the song title field

titlePlaceholder.where: Library > Upload dialog: song title field placeholder

keyLabel.where: Library > Upload dialog: label of the musical key picker

bpmLabel.where: Library > Upload dialog: label of the tempo field
bpmLabel.context: BPM = beats per minute; keep the abbreviation if it is the usual one.

bpmPlaceholder.where: Library > Upload dialog: tempo field placeholder (an example number)
bpmPlaceholder.context: An example tempo; normally left as 120.

tagsLabel.where: Library > Upload dialog: label of the tags field

tagsPlaceholder.where: Library > Upload dialog: tags field placeholder with example tags
tagsPlaceholder.context: Example search tags, comma-separated; translate the words, keep the commas.

sectionLabel.where: Library > Upload dialog: label of the library section (collection) picker

sectionUploads.where: Library > Upload dialog: library section option for user uploads

addToSetlist.where: Library > Upload dialog: label of the optional setlist picker
addToSetlist.context: Setlist = the ordered list of songs for a service.

dontAddToSetlist.where: Library > Upload dialog: first option of the setlist picker (no setlist)

uploading.where: Library > Upload dialog: upload button while uploading

fileTooLarge.where: Library > Upload dialog: error toast when the file is over the size limit
fileTooLarge.context: {max} is the size limit in megabytes; MB is the unit.

unsupportedType.where: Library > Upload dialog: error toast for an unsupported file type
unsupportedType.context: PDF, MusicXML, MuseScore are file formats; keep the names.

uploadFailed.where: Library > Upload dialog: error toast when the upload fails

uploadFailedStatus.where: Library > Upload dialog: error toast when the upload fails with an HTTP status
uploadFailedStatus.context: {status} is an HTTP status number, e.g. 500.

uploadedToast.where: Library > Upload dialog: success toast after upload

addToNext.where: Library > Upload dialog: button on the success screen that adds the chart just uploaded to the soonest upcoming service
addToNext.context: {setlistName} is the service's setlist name, e.g. 'Shabbat Morning — Nov 7'. Hebrew follows the existing 'נוסף לרשימה {setlistName}' pattern.

done.where: Library > Upload dialog: button on the success screen that closes the dialog without adding the chart to a setlist
